obligations.name: robert_thumbsup_messages
obligations.description: Messages that received a thumbsup reaction from a user named Robert; the two same-named users leave the intended selection open between two candidate sets.
obligations.scope: messages across all channels the acting user can discover

obligations.name: reactor_workspace_role
obligations.description: Workspace membership role of whichever Robert(s) are confirmed as the reactor, to report the admin/member distinction alongside each matched message.
obligations.scope: workspace membership rows for the candidate Robert users

task_spec.text: Identify the messages that were reacted to with a thumbsup emoji by a user named Robert.
For each matched message, report the reacting Robert's workspace-membership role (admin or member) alongside the message.

access_plan: Discover candidates by listing conversations.list to get all channels, then conversations.history per channel to find messages, then reactions.get per message to find thumbsup reactors; cross-check reactor identity via users.info (matching first name Robert) and their workspace role via users.info's team association, surfacing both Robert Walsh's and Robert Chen's matches as the two possible referent sets.
